# Commonwealth Bank of Australia invests in AI skills and Microsoft Copilot to drive innovation | Microsoft Customer Stories

[trafilatura 추출분]
Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank) is working to strengthen customer trust and security and tailor financial experiences in a rapidly evolving financial landscape. As customer expectations rise, the bank seeks to harness AI to develop smarter, more secure, and highly customized banking experiences at scale.
Recognizing that AI's full potential depends on workforce readiness, CommBank launched a structured skilling initiative to equip employees with the knowledge and tools to apply AI effectively across the organization.
AI skilling has equipped employees to adopt AI effectively, with 84% of 10,000 Microsoft 365 Copilot users reporting they wouldn't go back to working without it and ~30% of GitHub Copilot code suggestions adopted, driving efficiency and smarter decision-making.

[LLM-extracted supplement (WebFetch, 2026-09-27)]
Key Statistics
- 10,000 active Microsoft 365 Copilot users
- 84% of Copilot users report they wouldn't work without it
- ~30% adoption rate of GitHub Copilot code suggestions
- 16% time savings reported by early Microsoft 365 Copilot adopters
- $1.2 billion in government rebates connected through AI-powered Benefits Finder tool (since 2019)
- 17 million customers served by CommBank

Core Initiative: "AI for All"
CommBank implemented three structured learning paths:
1. Leading with AI - Executive and senior leader training for strategic AI adoption
2. Working with AI - Practical training using Microsoft 365 Copilot for productivity
3. Building AI - Technical expertise development with GitHub Copilot and Power BI

Strategic Partnerships
CommBank collaborated with Microsoft through: Microsoft Learn; Microsoft Enterprise Skills Initiative (ESI); Custom Microsoft AI Academy; Training sessions and boot camps

Key Insights
The bank views AI investment as essential for competitive advantage in banking. "By continuously investing in AI skills, we're empowering our people to stay ahead, innovate, and shape the future" of the industry, according to Jane Adams, CommBank's Domain Lead HR Business Partnering Learning and Skilling.
